svg.aria-label: What I am looking for: CONTRACT Work-study or internship; START February 2027; RHYTHM 35 h/week or more (work-study), flexible (internship); ROLES Backend, Data, AI, Full-stack...; LOCATION Nice / Sophia Antipolis, remote; PROGRAM 42 Next, 2025-2030. What you get: Contracts before code - Author of DRAFT, a public method that freezes requirements and invariants before implementation.; Strict by default - Python under mypy --strict and Flake8, C under the 42 norm, mutation and random-campaign testing before a commit.; Team delivery - Peer-reviewed 42 projects: a Go service, a C engine with event logs, a containerised infrastructure closed at full marks.; AI that stays engineered - Built HEXIS, a memory and skill system that keeps LLM agents scoped, cheap and auditable.
